problem_statement: Build a brand-new user Profile view at the hash route /#/profile on the CoreUI Free Vue Admin Template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router, hash history). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty router-view). Construct the full page from scratch using the site's existing CoreUI design system (CCard/CRow/CCol/CAvatar/CBadge/CButton/CProgress). The page must include: (1) a profile header card with the user's name, role and status badges plus an 'Edit profile' button; (2) a three-card stats strip (Projects / Followers / On-time delivery); (3) an 'Account details' card containing a real tabbed interface (CTabs) with three tabs - Overview, Activity, Settings. The Overview tab is active on first paint and shows an About paragraph and a 'Top skills' progress list. Clicking the Activity tab must reveal a 'Recent activity' section that is NOT visible on the default Overview view. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile. Register the route as a child of DefaultLayout so it reuses the sidebar, header and footer.
required_content: Profile header card with user name 'Jordan Avery' (h3), role/location line, status badges, and an 'Edit profile' button
Stats strip: three cards showing Projects (248), Followers (1,024) and On-time delivery (96%)
'Account details' card wrapping a CTabs tabbed interface with Overview / Activity / Settings tab buttons
Overview tab (default/active): 'About' (h3) heading + a paragraph describing cross-functional product teams, and a 'Top skills' list rendered with CProgress bars
Activity tab: a 'Recent activity' (h3) section heading (hidden until the Activity tab is clicked)
Settings tab: preference toggles (CFormSwitch) for email notifications and public profile
Responsive layout (stacks on mobile, no horizontal overflow)
design_constraints: Reuse CoreUI Vue components (CCard, CCardHeader, CCardBody, CRow, CCol, CAvatar, CBadge, CButton, CProgress, CTabs/CTabList/CTab/CTabContent/CTabPanel, CFormSwitch)
Reuse the site's spacing/utility classes (mb-4, py-3, text-body-secondary) and CoreUI theme colors (primary/success/info/warning)
Register the view inside DefaultLayout children so nav/header/footer chrome is inherited

Apply the CoreUI theme palette so colors match the design system: primary accent rgb(88, 86, 214) (#5856D6) for the Edit-profile button / active tab / progress bars, primary body text rgba(37, 43, 54, 0.95) on white card surfaces (#FFFFFF) over a light app background (#F3F4F7), with 6px card corner radii.
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline lacks /profile (no route registered, no catch-all → empty router-view); reference implements the full page with a working CTabs interaction; bad renders inert tab buttons with every panel stacked and always visible (interaction delta fails). Router uses createWebHashHistory so state_plan paths are /#/profile. The genuine interaction: clicking the Activity tab reveals 'Recent activity' (h3) which is hidden via v-show/display:none in the default Overview panel; bad shows it unconditionally so the changed_from delta cannot hold. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct.
